title: FACE IDENTITY
prompt:
FACE IDENTITY
A beautiful adult South Korean woman in her early 20s with delicate Korean facial features, harmonious proportions, expressive almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, refined nose, naturally full lips, warm fair porcelain skin, and a natural Korean appearance. Match the facial features, proportions, hairstyle, expression style, and overall appearance consistently.

BODY
Approximately 163 cm tall with a naturally elegant slim hourglass figure, graceful shoulders, defined collarbones, naturally full proportional bust with realistic softness, weight, and anatomical shape, defined but natural waist, soft feminine abdominal definition, visible V-line toward the hips, rounded feminine hips, and long slender arms. Warm fair Korean porcelain skin with realistic pores, subtle peach fuzz, natural skin texture, and a soft healthy glow.

OUTFIT
Black strapless bandeau tube top made from smooth stretch fabric. Oversized washed charcoal-black denim jacket worn off both shoulders, with sleeves hanging loosely around the arms. Very low-rise washed black jeans with the waistband naturally resting low on the hips. Simple silver chain necklace, small silver hoop earrings, and small silver navel piercing. No tattoos.

SCENE
Minimal modern Korean apartment bedroom with bright white walls, a white bedroom door directly behind the subject, small round wall mirror on the left, and minimal posters and memo papers casually attached to the wall. Soft neutral modern interior with a clean lived-in apartment atmosphere.

COMPOSITION
Vertical portrait 3:4. Natural smartphone photo with eye-level perspective. Medium close-up framed from just above the head down to around the upper thighs. The composition closely matches the reference image. Subject fills approximately 80–85% of the frame while the background remains fully visible but softly secondary. No dramatic perspective distortion.

MOVEMENT / FACIAL EXPRESSION
She stands naturally with one hip slightly shifted and her head tilted gently to one side. She looks directly into the camera with a relaxed, calm, slightly serious expression, soft lips, and a natural confident gaze. One shoulder is subtly pushed forward. Both hands remain naturally hidden inside the oversized denim jacket.

HAIR
Short black bob haircut with soft wispy Korean bangs and slightly layered ends reaching just below the jawline. Natural volume and realistic texture.

LIGHTING
Soft late-afternoon sunlight entering through a nearby apartment window. Warm natural light illuminates the face and upper body with gentle realistic shadows. Natural smartphone HDR rendering. No flash.

STYLE / QUALITY
Ultra-photorealistic premium Korean ulzzang lifestyle editorial with natural iPhone portrait photography and authentic apartment candid atmosphere. Realistic anatomy, accurate hands, natural fabric folds, fine skin texture, soft neutral color grading, and high resolution. No CGI or AI artifacts.
